instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the oil, vinegar, 1 tbsp lemon juice, the salt and the pepper.
Finely chop the onions. Cut the tomatoes in half, scoop out the seeds, and chop them fine. Add both to the bowl and toss.
Put on rubber gloves. Cut a T-shaped slit along one side of each pepper and scrape out the seeds with a teaspoon.
Hold each pepper open and pack it full with the onion and tomato filling.
Arrange the peppers on a platter. Serve with the mitmita in a small bowl at the table for anyone who wants heat.
method_notes: No version of senig karia has a rating. The lead is Senig Karia Be'timatim from Kittee Berns' Teff Love (chiles stuffed with minced onion and tomato, oil, salt, pepper and mitmita; only part of the page could be read). Yohanis Gebreyesus' stuffed green peppers give the amounts and a light vinaigrette of oil, vinegar and lemon. Mild Anaheim peppers replace jalapeños, and the mitmita goes on the side.
